flags.message: gemini-baseline, claude-baseline, and codex-baseline freeze band baseline under sal-v3 for Term 2026, but the committed metrics/statpack.md segment table is headed sal-v4. Per the evaluation contract, segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score are omitted and base_rate_basis is null for all three. A frozen band cannot use the terminal fallback. Outcome correctness and Brier scores are unaffected; individual evaluation.md files explain the unavailable baseline.
